decisions.decision: Product name: Fletcher (JK Simmons / Whiplash reference)
decisions.rationale: Reinforces the AI-teacher positioning; the joke is that this Fletcher is 'the teacher Fletcher should have been' — reinforcing not critical, celebrates hard-won achievements by grinders

decisions.decision: Fletcher voice contract: sharp diagnosis + coaching next step + confidence signal
decisions.rationale: Keeps Fletcher-vocabulary ('Rushing', 'Dragging', 'Not my tempo') as signature but delivers them as coaching, not putdowns. See .planning/design/fletcher-identity.md

decisions.decision: Multi-user seams resolved: users table + device UUID + X-User-ID header, no auth
decisions.rationale: Deferred from Phase 1, forced by Phase 2 onboarding creating first real user data. UUID generated per device, MMKV stores it, all API requests send X-User-ID

decisions.decision: 5-section onboarding wizard: Welcome / Play / Working on / Aspire / Preferences
decisions.rationale: Sectioned wizard beats conversational (40%+ abandon on chat) and standard-form (weakest voice). Welcome is the Fletcher joke-landing moment; each song category gets emotional weight; Aspire is the retention hook

decisions.decision: Free-text song input + Sonnet batch parse on Complete
decisions.rationale: Cheapest (~$0.02-0.05/user), most Fletcher-native voice fit. Single LLM call outputs both canonicalized songs and initial skill graph. Fail-open with bootstrap graph on failure

decisions.decision: Fixed root taxonomy: Rhythm / Lead / Chord Voicings / Fingerstyle / Music Theory / Timing
decisions.rationale: Sonnet writes sub-domains and leaves within these. Reduces Phase 4 dedup collision surface. Proposed values — iterate in Phase 2 UI-phase

decisions.decision: Normalized per-user skill_nodes tree; songs table with category enum + song_skills junction
decisions.rationale: Defers multi-parent DAG + canonical shared nodes to Phase 4. Aspirational retention hook lives at song level (query: skills where song.category=aspirational). Foundation for Phase 5 Library too

decisions.decision: All mastery starts at 0 after onboarding
decisions.rationale: Preserves 'deterministic writes only, no LLM in write path' from PROJECT.md. Sonnet writes structure; Phase 3 ratings write mastery

next_action: Run /gsd-ui-phase 2 (recommended — first heavy-UI phase, where Fletcher visual identity ships) OR /gsd-plan-phase 2 directly if you want to move faster
context_notes: Phase 1 shipped iOS end-to-end on Hernan's real iPhone — Sweet Home Chicago fetched from Railway, airplane-mode + force-quit + reopen served the cached song (PLAT-04 verified). Phase 2 discuss-phase produced 14 decisions with strong Fletcher-voice + data-model rigor. Phase 2 is the first heavy-UI phase (Phase 1 was scaffolding), and the natural home for Fletcher's visual identity to ship in real screens — hence the strong recommendation for /gsd-ui-phase 2 before /gsd-plan-phase 2. The user paused after CONTEXT.md landed; no in-flight work to recover, no unresolved blockers, no dirty tree.
